***Two Cantrips.*** You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat’s spells (choose when you select this feat).

***Level 1 Spell.*** Choose a level 1 spell from the same list you selected for this feat’s cantrips. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

summary: One new skill and Expertise in another.

name: Skilled
text:
You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

***Repeatable.*** You can take this feat more than once.

benefits.name: Repeatable
benefits.text: You can take this feat more than once.

choices.label: Skills or tools, in any mix

name: Skulker

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.summary: +1 Dexterity, max 20.

benefits.name: Blindsight
benefits.summary: Blindsight to 10 ft.

benefits.name: Fog of War
benefits.summary: In combat, Advantage on the Stealth check of a Hide action.

benefits.name: Sniper
benefits.summary: Missing an attack while hidden doesn’t give away where you are.

summary: Sense nearby foes and stay hidden while fighting.

name: Slasher

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.summary: +1 Strength or Dexterity, max 20.

benefits.name: Hamstring
benefits.summary: Once per turn on a Slashing hit, the target’s Speed drops 10 ft until your next turn starts.

benefits.name: Enhanced Critical
benefits.summary: A Slashing crit gives the target Disadvantage on its attacks until your next turn starts.

summary: Slashing hits slow foes, and crits throw off their attacks.

name: Speedy

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.summary: +1 Dexterity or Constitution, max 20.

benefits.name: Speed Increase
benefits.summary: Speed +10 ft.

benefits.name: Dash over Difficult Terrain
benefits.summary: After you Dash on your turn, Difficult Terrain costs no extra movement for the rest of it.

benefits.name: Agile Movement
benefits.summary: Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

summary: Faster, nimble over rough ground and hard to catch.

name: Spell Sniper

prerequisite.text: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.summary: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma, max 20.

benefits.name: Bypass Cover
benefits.summary: Spell attack rolls ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover.

benefits.name: Casting in Melee
benefits.summary: An enemy within 5 ft gives no Disadvantage to your spell attacks.

benefits.name: Increased Range
benefits.summary: A spell attack with a range of 10 ft or more gets +60 ft of range.

summary: Spell attacks reach farther and ignore cover and nearby enemies.

name: Tavern Brawler

benefits.name: Enhanced Unarmed Strike
benefits.summary: Your Unarmed Strike can deal 1d4 + STR Bludgeoning damage.

benefits.name: Damage Rerolls
benefits.summary: Reroll 1s on Unarmed Strike damage dice; keep the new roll.

benefits.name: Improvised Weaponry
benefits.summary: Proficiency with improvised weapons.

benefits.name: Push
benefits.summary: Once per turn, an Unarmed Strike hit during the Attack action can both deal damage and push the target 5 ft away.

summary: A scrapper with heavy fists and a knack for improvised weapons.

name: Telekinetic

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.summary: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma, max 20.

benefits.name: Minor Telekinesis
benefits.summary: Learn Mage Hand: no Verbal or Somatic components, the hand can be Invisible, and its range and leash grow by 30 ft. Cast with the ability you raised.

benefits.name: Telekinetic Shove
benefits.summary: Bonus Action: a creature you see within 30 ft makes a STR save (DC 8 + PB + the raised ability) or is moved 5 ft toward or away from you.

summary: Move objects with your mind and shove creatures from afar.

name: Telepathic

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.summary: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma, max 20.

benefits.name: Telepathic Utterance
benefits.summary: Talk telepathically to a creature you see within 60 ft in a language you know; it can’t reply that way.

benefits.name: Detect Thoughts
benefits.summary: Detect Thoughts always prepared; once per Long Rest cast it with no slot or components, otherwise with slots. Uses the ability you raised.

summary: Speak mind to mind and read thoughts.

name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
summary: Fighting style: +2 damage on ranged hits with Thrown weapons.

name: Tough
summary: Max HP rises by twice your level now, and by 2 more each level after.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
text: When you make an extra attack as a result of using a weapon that has the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack if you aren’t already adding it to the damage.

name: Unarmed Fighting
summary: Fighting style: your Unarmed Strike can deal 1d6 + STR Bludgeoning (1d8 with no weapon or Shield held), and at the start of your turn you can deal 1d4 Bludgeoning to one creature you grapple.

name: War Caster

prerequisite.text: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.summary: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma, max 20.

benefits.name: Concentration
benefits.summary: Advantage on CON saves to keep Concentration.

benefits.name: Reactive Spell
benefits.summary: When a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack by leaving your reach, Reaction: cast a 1-action spell targeting only it instead of attacking.

benefits.name: Somatic Components
benefits.summary: Do Somatic components with weapons or a Shield in your hands.

summary: Cast reliably in the thick of melee.

name: Weapon Master

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.summary: +1 Strength or Dexterity, max 20.

benefits.name: Mastery Property
benefits.summary: Use the mastery property of one Simple or Martial weapon kind you are proficient with; swap the kind after a Long Rest.

summary: Use one weapon kind’s mastery property.
